verdict.rationale: Treg documents runtime discovery and invocation. Agents search the catalog by intent (`/catalog/search`), each endpoint exposes its parameters and an example response, and a single `/call/` proxy reaches 3,800+ endpoints through one base URL. That is effectively a search-then-call pattern rather than preloading definitions, but the docs never show search and load offered as MCP meta-tools; the only named MCP tools are `review` and `balance`. missing for 10: explicit MCP search/describe/load meta-tools, documentation that tool definitions stay out of context, independent or hands-on corroboration of the runtime discovery flow.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context

citations.quote: Search by what you want to _do_, not by vendor: `GET /catalog/search?q=backlinks`.
Call any of 159 documented operations, or proxy a real request to any of 3,800+ catalogued provider endpoints through `/call/`.
Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response.
